motion_and_tilt.accessibility_override: When html.perf-mode or html.a11y-reduce-motion is active, disable CSS 3D float keyframes and pointer listener tilt.

layout_and_responsive.desktop_1920px: Magic Markup fluid grid, gap-6, 3-column or responsive split wide hero tiles
layout_and_responsive.card_structure: Single clickable <button> element per studio card keeping data-act and data-testid intact (studios-open-instrum, studios-open-image, studios-open-lyric)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure each studio card remains wrapped in a single clickable <button> element with its respective data-act and data-testid attributes.
Render the 3D floating graphics with CSS 3D perspective, layer separation, and parallax depth.
Support continuous floating motion via CSS keyframes with requestAnimationFrame smooth tilt tracking.
Respect light mode (.lsx-light), reduced motion (.a11y-reduce-motion), and performance mode (.perf-mode).
Match each studio card to its designated primary color accent and matching glow effect.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use dark colors as heavy flat backgrounds without subtle depth layers.
Do NOT use universal transition property (transition: all). Use specific property transitions.
Ensure all interactive buttons, cards, and links have explicit data-testid attributes for testing.
Maintain responsive layout from 390px mobile up to 1920px desktop viewports.
Ensure high text contrast ratios across dark and light modes.
